findings.title: Default credentials and no brute-force limit on the public Basic Auth gate
Slides and lab copies served without authentication
One shared password for every student's Linux and Forgejo account enables cross-student impersonation
Unauthenticated code-server and ttyd reachable from other containers on the lab network
Pull-request workflows run student-modified code on a shared host runner trusted by dns-api
Runner pool and app-host run as root with default capabilities
Slot exhaustion and head-of-line blocking in the single-threaded allocator
Credentials and session cookies in cleartext when served over HTTP
Shared ACME CA with a published default password issues certificates for other students' names
Other students' command lines, including lab secrets, visible through /proc
Shared DNS API key lets any student change or squat another student's zone
No request rate limiting and shared resource pools on internal lab services
Identity and control-plane actions are not logged
Allocator pages lack CSP and frame-ancestors and use inline script
Privileged Docker-in-Docker with a world-writable socket behind Dojo Cloud
Master secrets shared across many containers as plaintext environment variables
Single unseal share and long-lived root-equivalent provisioner token on the setup volume
Base images pulled by mutable tags
Plaintext internal transport to OpenBao and PostgreSQL
